name: postgres-tools
description: Postgres MCP server with a read-only connection: schema, context and SELECT queries. Writes are blocked by the core guard and must be impossible for the user you give it.

postgres_ro_url.title: Postgres read-only connection string
postgres_ro_url.description: postgresql://<read-only user>:<password>@<host>:5432/<database>. A read-only user only.
